location.story: The Girl Monkey And The String Of Pearls

approved_translation: Cleverness and careful observation can solve problems that force cannot.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: One day the king went for a long walk in the woods. When he came back to his own garden, he sent for his family to come down to the lake for a swim. Then he told the king about the trick he had played with the beads. "You are the right man in the right place," said the king, and he thanked the chief of the guards over and over again.
